```{python}
#| label: fig-technology-trend
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "CMOS technology scaling trend: minimum feature size (node name) versus year of first volume production, with key technology innovations annotated (data compiled from public sources, e.g., [wikichip.org](https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/technology_node))."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

nodes = [
    (1971, 10000), (1974, 6000), (1977, 3000), (1981, 1500), (1984, 1000),
    (1987, 800), (1990, 600), (1993, 350), (1996, 250), (1999, 180),
    (2001, 130), (2003, 90), (2005, 65), (2007, 45), (2009, 32),
    (2010, 28), (2012, 22), (2014, 14), (2016, 10), (2018, 7),
    (2020, 5), (2022, 3), (2025, 2), (2027, 1.6),
]
annotations = [
    (1971, 10000, 'silicon gate, PMOS (10 µm)', 'rt'),
    (1984, 1000, 'CMOS replaces NMOS logic (1 µm)', 'r'),
    (1990, 600, '200 mm wafer (600 nm)', 'r'),
    (2001, 130, '193 nm litho, 300 mm wafer (130 nm)', 'l'),
    (2007, 45, 'high-k/metal gate, immersion litho (45 nm)', 'l'),
    (2012, 22, 'FinFET, double patterning (22 nm)', 'l'),
    (2018, 7, '13.5 nm EUV litho (7 nm)', 'l'),
    (2022, 3, 'GAA, nanosheet MOSFET (3 nm)', 'l'),
    (2025, 2, 'backside power (2 nm)', 'rb'),
]

years = np.array([n[0] for n in nodes])
sizes = np.array([n[1] for n in nodes])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.semilogy(years, sizes, 'o-', color='tab:blue', lw=1.5, ms=4)
# ideal scaling reference line
ax.semilogy([1971, 2027], [10000, 1.6], 'r-', lw=1, alpha=0.7)

for yr, sz, txt, side in annotations:
    if side == 'r':
        ax.annotate(txt, xy=(yr, sz), xytext=(yr + 2, sz * 1.4),
                    fontsize=7, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.6))
    elif side == 'rt':
        # right and slightly below, in the empty area above the curve
        ax.annotate(txt, xy=(yr, sz), xytext=(yr + 9, sz * 0.9),
                    fontsize=7, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.6))
    elif side == 'rb':
        # right-aligned and below, in the empty area under the curve end
        ax.annotate(txt, xy=(yr, sz), xytext=(yr + 11, sz * 0.5),
                    fontsize=7, ha='right', va='center',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.6))
    else:
        ax.annotate(txt, xy=(yr, sz), xytext=(yr - 2, sz * 0.5),
                    fontsize=7, ha='right',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.6))

ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Feature size (nm)')
ax.set_xlim(1950, 2040)
ax.set_ylim(0.6, 13000)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
